This issue feels weird. Surely no one should be manually maintaining a list of all TODOs in mathlib? Either people look straight at the code, or some automation generates the list by scraping mathlib
I hadn't realized this list was literally just a scraped (and truncated) list of todos in Mathlib!
I agree that this doesn't seem like the best way to handle them. We could maybe have them tallied up as a form of tech debt? Though maybe that's not too useful of a metric.
